meta.note: avg_job_value_gbp figures are working estimates. Tune them from real discovery calls - they drive the arithmetic line in the email and are the single most important number in this file.

phone_evidence.sell: AI phone agent that answers every call in two rings, triages the emergency from the quote request, and texts the on-call engineer
phone_evidence.angle: customers are publicly saying they couldn't get through

no_review_replies.sell: review monitoring that alerts you to every new review and drafts a reply for approval
no_review_replies.angle: years of reviews with no reply from the business — free reputation sitting unclaimed, and the proof is public

hours_mismatch.sell: AI phone agent covering the hours you advertise but don't staff
hours_mismatch.angle: the website promises emergency cover, the opening hours stop at 5pm, and every call in between goes nowhere

no_booking.sell: online booking that writes straight into your diary
no_booking.angle: every appointment has to be made by phone, so anything that arrives while you're on a job is lost

no_email.sell: a proper enquiry inbox plus the AI phone agent
no_email.angle: the phone is the only way in, so a missed call is a missed customer with no second chance
